original_clauses.source_paraphrase: Chamberlain alleges that another attendee manually started Granola in a Teams or Zoom call and that her speech was captured and transcribed without her knowledge or consent; the docket shows filing but no merits determination.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The account holder’s authority to start a meeting transcription tool does not by itself establish the applicable basis for processing each other participant’s identifiable speech.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The complaint identifies at least one alleged meeting and processing path, but the permission, notice and participant-specific authority states remain untested.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: The complaint alleges on information and belief that Chamberlain’s meeting information was used for model training. Granola says it uses anonymised data for model improvement unless the account holder opts out; Enterprise training is off by default, and a non-user participant has no account setting.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The meeting-notes purpose and model-improvement purpose are distinct; a non-user participant’s contribution needs an independently established basis for any secondary use.
